toegepas.voor: kan vergeet word of anders onthou word
toegepas.na: kan vergeet of anders onthou word
toegepas.rede_vinder: The two passive verbs share one auxiliary, so the repeated 'word' is wooden.
toegepas.fout: The repeated passive auxiliary in 'kan vergeet word of anders onthou word' reads wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both verbs share one 'word' naturally in Afrikaans; same subject, same two senses, nothing lost.

toegepas.blok: Wat die kinders onder meer gevra het
toegepas.rede_vinder: A bare passive infinitive as subject reads clipped; the 'om ... te' form is the natural Afrikaans subject and matches the lesson's own 'Om 'n kind te boelie, is misbruik'.
toegepas.fout: A bare passive infinitive 'Gehoor word' as sentence subject reads clipped and makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Om gehoor te word, beteken' is the natural Afrikaans subject form, matches the lesson's own pattern, and keeps the meaning exactly.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The dependent clause follows the past 'wou hê', so the modal should be past too.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Afrikaans does not require sequence of tenses after 'wou he dat', so 'moet' is correct and natural; 'moes' is a lateral move that can also read as a past obligation.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Armoede alleen is nie verwaarlosing nie.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This protected sentence does not appear in the lesson; the 'verwaarlosing' entry instead ends with ''n Gesin se armoede alleen is nie 'n rede om 'n kind uit die gesin weg te neem nie.' A person may want to confirm which wording is intended.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat die kinders onder meer gevra het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'van geboorte af' is the fixed expression, and the list block already uses it.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'van sy geboorte af' is natural, correct Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat die Grondwet onder meer vir elke kind gee
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: sorg by sy gesin, en gepaste ander sorg
laat_vaar_vorige.na: sorg by sy gesin en ander gepaste sorg
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: No comma before 'en' between two parts of one phrase (AWS 2017), and 'ander' naturally comes before the adjective 'gepaste'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The comma keeps the 'as hy daaruit weggeneem word' condition on the second item only, and 'gepaste ander sorg' (appropriate alternative care) would shift towards 'other appropriate care'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'rondom jou' is the clearer, more natural way to say 'around you' here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'kinders om jou' is natural Afrikaans; 'rondom jou' is only a different wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Afrikaans needs 'van' between 'lys' and what is in the list.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die lys eise' is an accepted Afrikaans construction (like ''n lys name'), so this is no grammar error and glossary wording is not reworded for style.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sê aan' reads first as 'tell to'; 'wys aan watter land' avoids the misreading.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'aan watter land ... behoort' is natural Afrikaans, and 'wys aan' would carry the same supposed misreading, so the proposal fixes nothing in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: of te help leef met iets
laat_vaar_vorige.na: of te help om saam te leef met iets
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'leef met' copies English 'live with'; Afrikaans says 'saamleef met', and 'help' then takes 'om te'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'leef met' is established Afrikaans in health contexts, and the proposal makes a glossary definition longer and clumsier.
'daarvan' refers to 'hulp', and 'hulp bring' is correct; the swap would also repeat 'lewer' from the next sentence in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Ook organisasies wat die staat vir hierdie werk aangewys het, lewer hierdie dienste.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Organisasies wat die staat vir hierdie werk aangewys het, lewer ook hierdie dienste.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Sentence-initial 'Ook' before a long subject reads wooden; 'ook' sits naturally after the verb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Sentence-initial 'Ook' correctly puts the focus on organisations as well as workers; moving it shifts that focus to 'also these services' in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: As 'n reg nie nagekom word nie
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: maar dit gebeur nie altyd vanself nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: maar dit word nie altyd vanself nagekom nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'dit' points back to 'n reg', and a right does not 'happen' in Afrikaans (an English echo); 'nagekom' is the verb the block heading and the next sentence use, so the meaning stays the same.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'dit gebeur nie vanself nie' is a natural Afrikaans idiom here, while the proposal puts 'nagekom' three times in a row (heading, this sentence, the next) and pairs a passive with 'vanself' awkwardly, so it is a lateral move that disturbs its neighbour.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die handves en die Grondwet langs mekaar
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Lees die Grondwet se deel oor kinders langs die handves en jy sien
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Lees die Grondwet se deel oor kinders langs die handves, en jy sien
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The 'en' joins an imperative clause to a full clause with its own subject and verb ('jy sien'), so a comma helps; this is optional, because the imperative has no stated subject.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The first clause is an imperative with no subject of its own, so the house AWS rule does not require the comma, and the 'Lees X en jy sien Y' construction reads well without it, as the finder itself concedes.
